items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember the photograph of Peter Goldmark, the CBS engineer who was in charge of the project...

ctx.x: They were marketed partially because they had developed to the point where they were good enough to market and there had been this lull in recording. So it was a good time to make a switch like that. It caused quite a sensation. I remember the photograph of Peter Goldmark, the CBS engineer who was in charge of the project, which was an interesting thing. This project was not entirely in the hands of the recording engineers of the Columbia Records division, but it was in charge of Peter Goldmark, who was an…
